name: Roster
description: Every team, roster and player in one place. Browse by conference or division, open a club for its roster, then open a player for who he is and — in college football — his career stats and the high-school class he came out of. College football comes from CollegeFootballData with a recruiting board and a transfer-portal tracker; the NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL and league football come from ESPN, which needs no key. Nothing is ever fetched while a page is rendering.
author: Ernest Defoe
